description: Presidential Secretariat - Order to appoint Hon. K. T. Chitrasiri, Hon. P. S. Jayawardana & Mr. Kandasamy Velupillai as the Commissioners to investigate & inquire into and report CBSL matters w.e.f. - 27.01.2017
reasoning: This gazette establishes a Commission of Inquiry to investigate irregularities at the Central Bank of Sri Lanka. It is issued under the Commissions of Inquiry Act and outlines the legal framework, scope, and powers of the investigation. The content focuses on legal procedures, statutory compliance, and investigative authority rather than government personnel changes, structural reorganization, or any of the other specialized categories.
